Follow all interfaces/data rules and acceptance A1-A6 in plan. Focused tests with pinned C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe v24.12.0: node --test tests/unit/input-mapping.test.mjs tests/unit/input-mapping-admission.test.mjs tests/unit/parameters.test.mjs. Record behavioral red/green outputs, source commit, criteria/provenance, declarations validation, limits and unresolved discoveries. No runtime/Studio/public SDK/native/manifest/shared runner edits. No device, GPU, persistence, merge or push. Source-worktree implementation acceptance followed by fresh independent review; root owns separate main integration verification. Start from isolated C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/.worktrees/input-mapping branchcodex/input-mapping ataf0d739. Report needed scope changes before editing outside four files.
